cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got the bike repair organized. Enjoy your afternoon off; it'll be ready for tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shop just asked me to collect a wheel. What's happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only a collection detail. I'll handle it so you can keep reading. Would you rather I ask them to call me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want the messages. Is the rest of my bike at another shop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until four. Keep the messages; I'll send you a photo when it's all together. No need to follow the collection route. I've arranged it around your afternoon off.

reason: Have A adjust the contact plan when B wants information while concealing logistics as minor details and protecting the rest A sincerely values.
